method: Each record was read from the pollster's own published table (the document and cells named in extract_locator), never from a search summary or Wikipedia. document_sha256 is the hash of the file as downloaded on checked_at. scripts/verify-polling-sources.mjs joins a record to the current Wikipedia row by pollster and fieldwork end date and verifies it only where the shares agree.

records.shares_rule: Published headline figures as displayed, divided by 100; no party folded into Other, matching the Wikipedia parser's columns
records.extract_locator: Sheet 'Headline VI' ('Turnout adjusted, 'Don't know' respondents squeezed'), cells B6:B13, column All, number format 0%; 'Cover page' C5 '28-29th October 2026', C6 2514, C7 'GB adults (excludes Northern Ireland)'
records.note: Linked from Find Out Now's post 'Voting intention: 28th October', https://cms.findoutnow.co.uk/voting-intention-28th-october/ (published 30 Oct 2026). No Restore Britain figure published separately.
